subject: general
question: Which of the following is a tribe of Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jarawa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jarawa Tribe:**

 
 
• Indigenous people of the Andaman Islands in India.
 
• Inhabit parts of South Andaman and Middle Andaman Islands.
 
• Primarily hunter-gatherers, living in close connection with the forest.
 
• Considered a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) due to their isolation and vulnerability to outside influences.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ainu Tribe:**

 
 
• Indigenous people of Japan, primarily inhabiting the northernmost island of Hokkaido.
 
• Distinct language and culture, with unique traditions and beliefs.
 
• Historically marginalized and faced discrimination.
 
• Currently, efforts are being made to revitalize Ainu culture and language.
 
 
 
• **Tharu Tribe:**
 
 
• Primarily reside in the Terai region of Nepal and India (Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand).
 
• Known for their unique culture, traditional dance forms (like the Jhumar), and vibrant festivals.
 
• Primarily agricultural communities, with a strong connection to their land and natural resources.
 
 
 
• **Fulani Tribe:**
 
 
• One of the largest ethnic groups in Africa, spread across many countries including Nigeria, Cameroon, Senegal, and Mali.
 
• Primarily nomadic pastoralists, known for their cattle herding traditions.
 
• Rich cultural heritage, including music, dance, and intricate jewelry.
 
• Face challenges such as land disputes and climate change.
